entities.summary: Marlene Inemwin Moses is a diplomat and a political and administrative figure from Nauru. She has served since 2005 as the Nauruan Permanent Representative to the United Nations, with ambassadorial rank, having previously held consular responsibilities in Japan and New Zealand. She is also an expert in health administration.
